description: Decorator-first Python scheduler — cron/interval/at jobs with simple persistence and built-in run history.

summary.one_liner: A lightweight, decorator-based Python task scheduler supporting interval, cron, and one-time jobs, with async functions, timezones, persistence, and an optional FastAPI monitoring dashboard.
keywords: run python function on a schedule
use_cases: Run a Python function every N seconds, minutes, or hours
Schedule daily, weekly, or weekday-only jobs at set times in a specific timezone
Run cron-style recurring jobs such as every 15 minutes or first day of the month
Add a monitoring dashboard with run history and failed-job tracking to a FastAPI app
Persist scheduled jobs and history across restarts with SQLite or PostgreSQL
notable: Built-in run history, statistics, and dead letter queue for failed jobs
Chainable modifiers for timeout, retries with exponential backoff, timezone, and skip catch-up
Pluggable storage: JSON file by default, SQLModel database, or a custom StorageBackend subclass
Real-time dashboard over Server-Sent Events with run/pause/resume/cancel actions
caveats: Cron, database, and dashboard features need optional extras installed separately
Dashboard requires FastAPI integration; core scheduler runs in-process only
README does not describe distributed or multi-instance coordination beyond saying database storage suits multiple instances
